summary: CXApp Inc. filed an 8-K/A amending its June 3, 2026 report regarding the acquisition of 100% of Virtus Digital Marketing Pty Ltd (Engine Room Applications) by its subsidiary CXAI Australia Pty Ltd. The amendment states that after completing acquisition accounting and updated valuation, the transaction no longer meets quantitative significance thresholds under Item 2.01, so no separate financial statements or pro forma information are required. Terms such as price or premium were not disclosed. The acquisition closed on June 3, 2026, and EngineRoom's results are included in CXAI's Q2 2026 financials. Watch for integration updates and any subsequent disclosures on purchase price allocation.
